name: Expressions and acting
summary: Give Cog 12 readable emotions, natural blinks, snappy eye darts and reactions that wind up, pop and arrive part by part.
qualityBar: 12 emotions inside the art's safe range, every pair different in pixels, each in its expected valence/arousal quadrant (readFace)
Blinks: deterministic, gaps 2.2-5.0 s, mean 3-4.4 s, doubles 0.28 s apart, shut at 0.06 s and open at 0.20 s, closing faster than opening, eyes shut under 6 percent of the time
Eye darts 90 percent done in 0.08 s, never dead during a hold, head trails the eyes 0.08-0.2 s
Beats: eyes before brows before mouth, wind-up hands over to the reaction without a jump, outBack overshoots and settles, no value jumps more than 0.25 in 1/120 s
Demo: 1080x1920, 7.5 s, silent, QC pass, nothing frozen
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (75 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 1080x1920, 7.5 s, silent; engine QC on the card and the mp4 passed). I viewed the 12 emotion faces twice (after fixing a pale ring around squinting eyes by switching lids to clip regions, which also touched t4.1's drawEye: t4.1 was re-tested) and a 12-frame story sheet of the demo. NOT checked: the wind-up (windUp) was changed after the last viewed story sheet and re-tested by numbers only; emotion readability was judged by me and by the readFace formula, not by any viewer; the valence/arousal formula is a heuristic I wrote, not a validated model; motion was not played back by a person; no audio.
